goal: Compare the five most popular open-source vector databases for a small startup.

children.title: Pick the five databases
children.instructions: Name the five most popular open-source vector databases today, by GitHub stars and production use. Give just the names.

template.title: Research {{item}}
template.instructions: Summarise {{item}} for a small startup team: licence, hosting options (self-hosted and managed), what it is good and bad at, rough cost at 1-10 million vectors, and how hard it is to operate. Use short bullet points.

children.title: Compare them side by side
children.instructions: Build a comparison table of the databases across licence, hosting, performance, cost and operational effort, then note the two or three differences that matter most for a small startup.

children.title: Write the recommendation
children.instructions: Write a one-page recommendation for a five-person startup building a RAG feature. Pick one database, name a runner-up, and say when the answer would change.
